description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling files within the RomRaider ECU logging and tuning application. It offers functions for retrieving files, configuring file chooser dialogs, and saving profiles to disk.

classes.name: FileHelper
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for file handling operations such as retrieving files, configuring file choosers, and saving user profiles.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object based on the provided file path or defaults to the user's home directory if the path is null or empty.

methods.name: getProfileFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser configured for selecting ECU logger user profile XML files, initialized to the last used profile file.

methods.name: getDefinitionFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser for selecting ECU logger definition XML files, initialized to the last used definition file.

methods.name: saveProfileToFile
methods.description: Serializes a UserProfile object to an XML file, appending the .xml extension if missing, and returns the file path.

methods.name: getLoggerOutputDirFileChooser
methods.description: Creates a JFileChooser set to select directories for logger output, initialized to the last used directory if it exists.
